decisions.scenario: Getting contact details for an international restaurant without a price preference

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm looking for a restaurant serving international food anywhere in town.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are three international restaurants. Do you have a price preference?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No, I don't mind the price.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Bloomsbury Restaurant serves international food. It is at Crowne Plaza Hotel, 20 Downing Street, and the phone number is 0871 942 9180. Can I help with anything else?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Thank you. Have a wonderful day!
